## smyx-eye-anomaly-detection-analysis v1.0.2 Changelog

- Removed the file `skill-card.md`.

**Summary:**  
Major update with streamlined user flow, internalized user identity handling, and improved documentation.

- User identity (open-id) handling is now fully internal and automatic; users no longer need to input or see identity parameters.
- Historical report queries and all analysis workflows have removed any user-facing identity prompts for enhanced privacy and simplicity.
- Documentation (SKILL.md) has been comprehensively reorganized and clarified, focusing on user-oriented steps, automatic system behaviors, and strict privacy controls.
- Removed redundant files and updated scripts for improved maintainability and adherence to new workflow.
- API usage, abilities, and constraints are now more clearly described, including tabled requirements and use cases.

- Initial release of AI-powered pet eye anomaly detection from images or video.
- Detects conjunctival redness, abnormal tearing/tear stains, and pupil/cornea opacity (e.g., cataract or corneal edema).
- Outputs structured anomaly alerts with severity grading and home care recommendations.
- Supports daily self-check, boarding/routine inspection, hospital triage, and senior pet monitoring scenarios.
- Includes strict open-id retrieval and history report access protocols to ensure user data integrity and accurate API calls.
